top_signal.title: New to e commerce business and website development.
top_signal.summary: Hi homies,   I’m completely new to online business and I’m trying to build a website for my bone inlay MOP inlay handicraft business by myself.   I know some basics of website development. If I had to rate myself, maybe I’m around 0–75/100 😅. I can understand and build some things, but there is still a LOT that I don’t know, especially when it comes to actually running an online business.   So I wanted to ask for some help and advice from people who have experience with e-commerce, websites, marketing, or small businesses.   Right now, I’m confused about a lot of things like:   How to target core customer from USA, Europe, and other well developed countries?   What should I focus on first when building my website?   How do I make the website simple and easy for customers to use?   What kind of UI/UX should I follow?   Which colours, fonts, buttons, layouts, etc. work well for an online handicraft store?   Which payment gateway is good for a small business, affordable and reliable?   What should I do for SEO from the beginning?   How can I make my website visible on Google?   What kind of customer information should I collect, and how should I do it properly?   Which analytics tools should I use to understand my customers?   How do I build trust with new customers when they don’t know my brand yet?   How important are reviews, return/refund policies, product photos, shipping information, etc.?
